plink2.label: PLINK 2
plink2.description: Convert genotype files, calculate quality-control statistics, filter samples and variants, and perform regression. Numbered commands use the real cohort; the regression control is explicitly synthetic.
plink2.argumentsHelp: Enter PLINK 2 flags without the program name. Examples use one compute thread and a 640 MiB analysis arena. The supported compute-thread range is 1–2. PCA and other LAPACK-dependent commands are unavailable.

convert.label: 1. Convert 1000 Genomes VCF
convert.description: Convert the supplied real chromosome 21 genotypes to PLINK 2 files. Run this first; subsequent quality-control commands use the generated cohort files.

qc.label: 2. Summarize genotype quality
qc.description: Report allele frequencies, sample and variant missingness, and Hardy–Weinberg statistics. These describe the supplied subset; they do not establish clinical interpretation.

filter.label: 3. Filter genotypes
filter.description: Keep variants with minor allele frequency at least 0.01 and missingness at most 0.1, and samples with missingness at most 0.1. These example thresholds are editable.

export.label: Export the cohort as VCF
export.description: Export the converted, unfiltered cohort to an uncompressed VCF. The original genotype inputs remain available.

linear.label: Synthetic control: linear regression
linear.description: Run linear regression on explicitly synthetic genotypes, phenotype and covariates. This checks software behavior and is separate from the real 1000 Genomes cohort.

help.label: Command help
help.description: Display PLINK 2 help. Request help for particular flags by adding them after --help.

plink2.label: 1000 Genomes and synthetic regression control
plink2.description: A real 1000 Genomes chromosome 21 VCF with 2,504 samples and 600 variants, plus a separate, explicitly synthetic regression control. The files are for demonstrating and validating software.
